findings.suggested_fix: Only attach the shared context when no client cert is in play: `elif verify is True: if client_cert is None: pool_kwargs["ssl_context"] = _preloaded_ssl_context else: pool_kwargs["ca_certs"] = extract_zipped_paths(DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH)` (the old per-pool behavior, so load_cert_chain happens on a pool-private context). Alternative: build and cache a separate preloaded context per (cert_file, key_file). Assumption: client-cert users accept the per-pool load_verify_locations cost.
